wood.etude: Standard wooden double-leaf dungeon door. STRAIGHT-ON orthographic front elevation UV texture, entirely FULL BLEED, NO surround or padding. Portrait 4:5. Construct TWO equally wide independent wooden leaves with a distinct continuous shadow line at EXACTLY x50% from the TOP to the BOTTOM. The design is mechanically impeccable. Each leaf has three wide vertical russet-walnut boards. The two leaves are hinged on OPPOSITE OUTSIDE EDGES: four clearly visible separate iron strap hinges in total, two coming in from the left edge and terminating within the left leaf, and two mirrored coming in from the right edge terminating within the right leaf, at about 21% and 79% height. EACH ends at least 12% before the center line. Show side knuckles. One small iron keyed escutcheon mounted completely on RIGHT leaf, keyhole centered around x61%, y68% of full door; a tiny separate keeper on left leaf at same height. No central plate shared between leaves, no second lock, no middle hinges, no single unbroken bar joining leaves. Rework the warm wood and dark iron in the supplied mood reference; dark hand-painted stylized mobile dungeon with broad planes and controlled steel edge highlights. Keep the wood brown readable against blue-slate dungeon walls. Entire image only the two wooden surfaces, FULL BLEED. NO stone frame, arch border, environment, floor, viewing angle, seam through the lock, metal trim around image, checkerboard, text or labels. The game mesh crops the top corners, keep features away from them.

Keep the two wooden leaves width and full-height joint exactly at half canvas, four black wrought iron strap hinges facing one another from opposite OUTER edges, two on each side, and the exact same restrained dark brown hand-painted timber. ERASE BOTH of the small metal key fittings near the bottom middle (the right keyhole escutcheon and the small left receiver). Continue the existing brown vertical planks into those TWO small areas, with clear thin black closing seam. The center area spanning x40%–60% at y60–77% is plain wooden boards. Deliver the entire rectified flat straight-on rectangular door filling the canvas at 4:5 image aspect. NO lock, keyhole, hasp, handle, horizontal bolt or other fitting in that blank space: the separate lock plate will be put there by the game artist. No frame, references, extra background, stone or copy. Keep light and brushwork as uploaded.

True alpha all around.

arcane.prompt: Magic DOUBLE-LEAF dungeon door. Portrait 4:5 FULL BLEED straight-on orthographic UV texture of the two leaves only. ABSOLUTELY NO frame, scene, external arch rim, ground or surround. Blued obsidian iron, two solid symmetrical leaves of equal width, a deep hairline vertical straight physical divide AT X50% from extreme TOP TO BOTTOM, including through the central rune. One bright violet binding seal made from TWO halves that ONLY align when the doors meet: on left one semicircular rune around a half diamond crystal carved in the inner side of left leaf; on right its matching semicircle and half diamond carved into right leaf. Together a radiant divided iris-like lozenge with wide segmented circular amethyst glyph ring at x50%, y38%, spans 44% door width. Thin hairline across the jewel proves that each half stays attached to its own leaf. No actual rigid piece across the gap. Elegant angular engraving guides the eye to the seal, two separate corner recesses on each leaf. Two discreet obsidian pivot fittings at each outside edge. Restrict violet light to seal, dark surrounding stone-metal readable mobile, forbidding and sculpted. No mundane lock or keyhole, extra gems, lettering, horizontal bar spanning both leaves, large borders. Surface fills image right to all four edges. Translate reference to frontal view, do not paint masonry.

grille.prompt: Dungeon Empire, stylized hand-painted mobile 2D fantasy dungeon sprite material for the LEAF ONLY. Use the supplied isometric reference as a MATERIAL / mood reference, but deliver a completely STRAIGHT-ON, rectified flat FRONT ELEVATION, horizontal horizontal bars, vertical verticals, parallel sides, no foreshortening, NO perspective. Orthographic UV texture to map onto a game mesh. Portrait aspect roughly 4:5. The low curved crown will be cropped in-engine from the top 14%, leave that area as continuous door material. Broad painterly planes, firm almost-black contact seams, restrained blue-slate edge highlights, soft light from upper left, readable shapes at 50px width. Ominous understated underground utilitarian craftsmanship; no gold, no torches, no hero ornaments. No masonry, floor, jamb, environment, frame, text, panels of examples or mockup. A single isolated iron portcullis, front orthographic elevation. Entire grate visible on fully transparent background, and ALL negative spaces BETWEEN the bars are transparent also. FIVE equally spaced broad vertical forged iron bars, quadrangular section with a readable cool left highlight and charcoal right face, terminating downward in sturdy tapered spear points. Two strong horizontal riveted cross rails at 30% and 64% height bind the grid into one working assembly. Blued iron, wrought black steel, a few restrained rust-violet shadows. A rectangular flat top across all rods for later arch masking. NO OUTER FRAME, side surround, wood, wall, door backing, solid rear panel, padlock, keyhole, handle, lever or chain. This slides UP by remote lever. Enough open space to see the game behind it. Broad, bold, dangerous, readable. Clean alpha around individual rods.
